Federal.scope: Federal spending mix; not restricted to individual income-tax revenue
Federal.source_location: PDF page 2, FY2025 column (millions of dollars)
Federal.notes: Other is the published total minus the seven named categories; it includes other functions and negative offsetting receipts. Payroll taxes are not estimated. Spending is financed by multiple revenue types and borrowing; this is a proportional illustration.

State.scope: Income Tax and Uniform School Funds
State.source_location: Table 6, printed page 1-15, FY2027 Appropriated column (thousands of dollars)
State.notes: Source rows are rounded to thousands; displayed rows sum to 8,090,824 versus published 8,090,822. Shares use the sum of displayed rows. Transfers are shown once and not allocated again to recipient funds. Some fund uses are restricted; this is a fund-level illustration, not a legal tracing of income-tax payments.

rows.category: Transfers to other accounts and funds

County.scope: Countywide property-tax spending mix, excluding the separate library levy
County.source_location: Printed pages 10-11 (PDF pages 11-12): countywide rate and uses of property taxes
County.weight_unit: tenths of a cent per total property-tax dollar
County.notes: Spending shares use the adopted Budget in Brief snapshot: 7.1, 2.9, 1.6, 0.8 and 0.5 cents of an overall property-tax dollar, normalized within the county share. The tax scenario separately uses the approved 2026 countywide levy sum of 0.001349 (general operations, bond, flood control, tort, recreation, capital improvements and health); the library levy and school/district taxes are excluded. These snapshot shares approximate allocation and do not trace the legal use of each levy.

City.scope: General Fund departmental expenditures; city tax scenario covers the general operations levy only
City.source_location: Printed page 28, General Fund Expenditures, FY26 Adopted Budget column
City.notes: A historical FY2025-26 adopted spending snapshot is used, not the newer FY2026-27 total. Later amendments are not included. Non Departmental is a published category, not synonymous with administrative salaries. Its transfers are counted once. The city scenario uses the 2026 general operations levy of 0.002374 only; separate library, bond, tort and judgment levies are excluded. Allocation assumes that levy follows the overall General Fund spending mix, including spending supported by other revenues.
